name: moody-suit-portrait
image_purpose: male suit, mirror, color, and dramatic lighting reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic luxury lifestyle mirror portrait of an approved adult man.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult man with short tapered hair, natural stubble, confident neutral expression, navy tailored suit jacket, black turtleneck, white pocket square, and smartphone in right hand.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered 3:4 bathroom mirror portrait, face and phone focal points, navy/black/wood/white palette, dark wood vanity, towel, and understated luxury setting.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Directional warm low-key overhead lighting, deep shadows under brow and jaw, preserved highlights on face, hair, suit, and phone.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic digital photography, portrait 3:4, straight-on perspective, tack-sharp subject, medium depth of field, subtle digital noise.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult man in a navy tailored suit jacket over a black turtleneck takes a centered bathroom mirror selfie, with a white pocket square and smartphone visible. Use dark wood, warm directional low-key lighting, deep controlled shadows, sharp face and suit detail, and sophisticated luxury lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted reflection, extra fingers, warped phone, plastic skin, overexposure, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
